name: higgsfield
one_liner: Pay-as-you-go REST API and hosted MCP server for generating image and video with many AI models.
auth_notes: Server-side Authorization: Key KEY_ID:KEY_SECRET created in Higgsfield Console; legacy hf-api-key/hf-secret headers also accepted. No OAuth for the API; the hosted MCP uses account sign-in.
access_notes: Self-serve console key, billed against a prepaid USD account balance (funds expire after one year); not a free tier and not a subscription plan, and the enum has no pay-as-you-go value.

buildability.rationale: Documented REST API with webhooks, estimate endpoint and key auth, but requires a funded prepaid balance. Async generation, concurrency-based limits, outputs deleted after 7 days.

needs_human_reason: No enum value for prepaid pay-as-you-go. MCP URL comes from a third-party search snippet, not a fetched vendor page.

disputes.why: Official rate-limits page documents concurrency limits, queueing, 429 with Retry-After.
Third-party search snippet cites this hosted endpoint; scalekit confirms official hosted MCP. Not verified on a vendor page.
Prepaid funded balance is required to spend; closest enum value to a payment gate.

auth.quote: The API also accepts the legacy `hf-api-key` and `hf-secret` headers.

access.quote: Funds added to your account balance expire one year after they are added.

api_surface.quote: The primary generation limit is concurrency: the number of requests that may be processing at the same time.
Pass an HTTPS endpoint in the `hf_webhook` query parameter when submitting generation.

mcp.quote: Higgsfield runs a hosted, remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, launched in spring 2026

buildability.quote: Request files are kept for seven days after the request finishes, then deleted.
